organization: World Bank / Government of Himachal Pradesh
notes: Board approval Feb 10, 2026: $245 million 'Resilient Action for Development and Disaster Recovery Himachal Pradesh Project' benefiting 2.3 million people. State suffered an estimated $1 billion in losses from extreme weather over the past three years; heavy rainfall in the 2023 and 2025 monsoons caused deaths and damage to housing/infrastructure. Project includes strengthening early warning systems (with Agence Francaise de Developpement), rehabilitation of 250+ bridges/roads/footbridges, hazard and risk analysis, 'resilience cells', and aims to mobilize $100 million in private capital for disaster-risk financing and insurance. Prepared with GFDRR support; CDRI provides knowledge support.
recommended_action: Offer multi-hazard monitoring, hazard/risk analytics, and historical event intelligence to the project's resilience cells and early-warning component; engage implementing state agencies and GFDRR/CDRI knowledge channels.
